integrity: Algebraic proof via an explicit nine-state transfer determinant; standalone exact symbolic and enumeration verifier. Same-model review only; independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform positive antiferromagnetic bond penalty, three named Potts colours, N=2n >=6, no magnetic field. The result does not classify nonzero-field minima or establish a thermodynamic phase transition. Historical priority remains provisional pending independent literature review.
title: Residue-three frustration and quadratic ground-state multiplicities on three-colour Potts antiprisms
